_doc: The Integrate step's picks (2026-09-29): which part-lane result the canonical build and the canonical stills use. build_rosace_v2.py reads 'build' (the environment still wins: ROSACE_OUTFIT, ROSACE_GLAIVE, ROSACE_HAIR, so lane drivers build their own variants); stills_v2.py reads 'stills' (--plain skips every lane pass and gives the pre-integration chain). The pose-side picks are folded into art/rosace/poses/*.json (see 'poses'). Change a pick here, then rebuild; PIPELINE.md 3.6g has the order and the reasons.

poses.glaive-hands: art/rosace/hands/poses/<pose>.json copied whole (the canonical pose plus the lane's weapon, hands, fingers, poles, stole and sleeve drape): idle_hero, n1_contact, q_stamp, n2_pivot
poses.outfit: pose_patches.json qtab (q_stamp) + hair and tabn2 (n2_pivot) deep-merged on top: R2Q's round-2 set, the one its critic preferred

why.outfit: R2Q, not R3K3: the round-3 critic did not prefer R3K3 over R2Q (both 6/10); round 2 was the outfit round the critic preferred. R3K3's stocking and boot ramps would be re-banded by the shading stage anyway
why.hair: r2f with pixel preset p1h_nowin minus 'tips' (the lane's round-2 pick p1h, two steps dropped at integration: the brow windows turned the F2b brows into a second pair of shut eyes in skin patches over the eyes (idle 144; the lane's own fallback p1h_nowin, ART-RULES O-28), and the A3/A4 fringe tips drew a blue streak down the nose where N1's centre clump ends between the eyes). The hue trial runs after the shading remap but shifts palette.json's indigo, not the remapped one: shifted from the shading lane's desaturated indigo the hair went grey-lavender and lost its read against the dark stockings (side by side in review/rosace/art/integrated/trials/)
why.glaive: l5 build, r3 fists, 80 px procedural rose, N1 smear (the lane's round-2 pick)
why.face: F2b composer (ROSACE_FACES=f2) on the per-still face pass: re-anchors every face to the v2 head (the canonical round-4 stamps lost the 144 idle mouth)
why.shading: preset r3g: the round-2 critic's one win for the lane was o's dark stockings, which g keeps; g brings back the warm skin and gold the control won on
why.wh2: Round WH2 (2026-09-29, the whole-character critique at 5-5.5/10): the build takes the figure-pose lane's bust S7 (+42% volume, lift 4, projection 0.22; the critique asked to bring back the control's bust volume, DESIGN 3.5) and a deeper waist pinch (0.17 -> 0.25, about 2 px at 144); the stills end with tools/art-construct/wh2_px.py before the remap: faces re-anchored on facepass with an expression per pose (idle smirk, N1 focused, Q fierce open-eyed, back glance), a dedicated 80 px face, hair despeckled with one dark tone, clump separators and one sheen arc, azure tips stepped down, the crown pin as one cluster, fists a value under the cuff, the thighs as cylinders
